race.name: Human
race.physicalDescription: Adaptable people found across nearly every region, with highly varied appearances, cultures, and traditions.

appearance: Young, carefully groomed, and visibly uncomfortable in ceremonial clothing.
backstory: An idealistic heir was educated abroad and returned to find the family profiting from abuse.
goals: Reform the domain without provoking a coup from relatives or retainers.

traits: Suspicious of all magic except one obviously fraudulent superstition followed with complete devotion.
Apologizes to every defeated enemy and becomes offended if the apology is rejected.

racialTraits.physicalAbility: Relentless Endurance: Humans suffer reduced fatigue from prolonged travel, heat, marching, pursuit, and repeated physical activity.

rules.name: Thread RULE
rules.description: Create and control a few meters of thread within sight; stronger fibers require carried material, and control weakens sharply with distance.

rules.name: Paper RULE
rules.description: Fold paper into briefly animated tools or creatures; water, fire, and heavy force destroy them easily.

talents:
Beast Friend — +2 when calming or understanding ordinary animals.
Ambidextrous — The character can use either hand with equal precision.
equipment: Common light armor — Ordinary clothing or light padding that offers mobility but no meaningful AR.
Spear — A long-reaching weapon useful for thrusting, bracing, and throwing.
Scimitar — A broad curved sword designed for fluid cutting attacks.
inventory: Herbalism pouch — Small tools and containers for gathering useful plants.
Crowbar — A sturdy iron lever for doors, crates, and obstacles.
